high_level_description: The image features a person posing for a photograph. The individual is wearing a sleeveless, gold sequined dress with thin black straps. The dress has a shimmering, reflective quality due to the sequins. The person is also adorned with long, dangling earrings that have a gold color and intricate designs, including what appears to be a small pendant at the bottom of each earring. A matching gold necklace with a circular pendant is visible around the neck. The background is plain white, which helps to highlight the subject and their attire.
